name: Policy Gradient 101: one REINFORCE step exposed
description: Prints the loss, the advantages and log pi(a|s)

data.noteContent:
REINFORCE is the simplest policy gradient: take a trajectory, then push up the log-probability of the actions that did better than average. Edu-PolicyGradient is that update with its insides on the ports: one run shows log pi(a|s) for the action taken, the advantages and the scalar loss. The advantages come out 0.69, 0.06, -0.02 and -0.73, summing to zero because the baseline is their mean, and the loss is -0.128. A policy-gradient loss is negative as often as not: it is not an error being driven to zero, it is the quantity whose gradient moves the policy. C5-2 adds the clip this one leaves out.

REINFORCE 是最簡單的策略梯度：拿一條軌跡，把表現優於平均的那些動作的對數機率往上推。Edu-PolicyGradient 就是這一步更新，而且把中間量都接到輸出埠上，跑一次就看得到全部：實際採取的動作的 log pi(a|s)、優勢，還有純量損失。照目前的設定，優勢是 0.69、0.06、-0.02、-0.73，加起來是零，因為基準就是它們的平均；損失是 -0.128。策略梯度的損失是負的很正常：它不是要壓到零的誤差，而是要用它的梯度去推動策略的那個量。C5-2 會補上這裡沒有的 clip。

Shape 4 by 3: one score per action, for three actions at each of four timesteps. A row's softmax is the policy at that state, and temperature divides the row first -- the lower it is, the greedier. These numbers are random, so the policy itself means nothing.

形狀是 4x3：四個時間步，每步三個動作各一個分數。一列取 softmax 就是那個狀態下的策略，而 temperature 會先除這一列，越小越貪心。這些數字是隨機的，所以策略本身沒有意義。

baseline mean subtracts the batch-average reward, which is why the four advantages sum to zero. Set it to none and the advantages become the raw rewards: the same run then prints +0.0345 instead of -0.1283. The node stops at the loss; BackwardOnce takes the gradient.

baseline 設 mean 會減掉批次平均獎勵，所以四個優勢加起來是零。改成 none 之後，優勢就是原始獎勵，同一次執行印出來的會是 +0.0345，而不是 -0.1283。這個節點只算到損失；負責取梯度的是 BackwardOnce。
